title: Vanish Airbrush Primer Jumbo
descriptionHtml:
✓ Gluten Free✓ Without Sulfates SLS & SLES✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Alcohol Free✓ Without Parabens
What it is: A skin-perfecting primer that smooths complexion, controls shine, and provides a blurred, airbrushed finish while extending makeup wear.

Skin Type: Normal, Oily, and Combination

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, phthalates, mineral oil, and sulfates SLS & SLES. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Formulated with innovative microspherical powders, this multipurpose primer blurs imperfections, minimizes the look of pores and fine lines, and absorbs excess oil for an immediate, skin-perfecting finish.

Clinical Results: Based on a consumer test on 31 participants:
- 96% said oil is absorbed all day
- 96% said skin instantly looks more even and texture i
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Smooth onto moisturized skin with fingertips.
-Start with one pump and add more if needed.
-Follow with your desired foundation.
Ingredients+
Dimethicone, Water/Aqua, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Vinyl Dimethicone/Methicone Silsesquioxane Crosspolymer, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Silica, Glycerin, Cetyl Peg/Ppg-10/1 Dimethicone, Isododecane, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium Chloride, Dimethicone/Peg-10/15 Crosspolymer, Magnesium Sulfate, Sodium Benzoate, Disteardimonium Hectorite, C24-28 Alkyl Methicone, Propylene Carbonate, Dipropylene Glycol, Sodium Citrate, Tocopherol.

Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of Hourglass’s commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
